messages:
maya: quick ping — compact-mini q4 canary showing a strange 'glyph shuffle' on mixed Han + Arabic lines. short metrics:
- fp32 BLEU: 27.6 chrF: 53.8
- q8 BLEU: 27.4 chrF: 53.5
- q4 BLEU: 22.0 chrF: 48.0 (mixed-orient subset)

maya: example input used in repro:
```
你好، مرحبا (世界)
```

maya: fp32 decode: "你好، مرحبا (世界)"
maya: q4 decode: "好你، مرحبا )世界("  (Han char order flipped inside parens and parentheses mirrored)

cheng: interesting — could be normalization + bidi ordering. did the q4 bundle change pre-normalize flag or ordering? i'll diff tokenizer meta + unicode lib versions.

li-wei: quick tokenizer dump with our packaged tokenizers vs sentencepiece:
- sentencepiece: ['你好', '،', ' ', 'مرحبا', ' ', '(', '世界', ')']
- tokenizers (q4 bundle): ['你', '\u200b', '好', '،', ' ', 'مرح', '\u200c', 'با', ' ', ')', '世界', '(']
(note: extra zero-width tokens and split within Arabic word)

ashwin: i ran the q4 runtime with --no-chunked-emit and tokens align with fp32. with chunked emit enabled the decoder buffer shows extra 0xE2 0x80 0x8B at boundaries. suspect emit-utf8-chunk change.

sahil: confirming: fused emit + compact quant path introduced a tail-copy optimization. bisect shows commit a1b2c3 correlates with inserted ZWSP bytes when multibyte codepoints cross chunk boundary. i'll attach velo trace and a tiny C repro.

eval-bot: CI scan https://ci.redwood/run/9401 -> regression on multilingual/mixed-orient-v1 (delta BLEU -5.6). artifacts: artifacts/9401/glyphshuffle.jsonl

maya: plan: 1) @cheng verify normalization flags and tokenizer build id for q4, 2) @li-wei run the gist repro across full mixed set and produce token diffs, 3) @sahil/ashwin triage fused-emit bisect and try rollback in q4 canary, 4) i'll open INF-1337 and upload failing samples + CI run. if tokenization alone reproduces we patch tokenizer; otherwise revert kernel change.

cheng: pushed small PR that forces NFKC pre-tokenize and strips stray ZW* markers before decode (branch fix/force-nfkc-strip). will test whether that recovers BLEU on the repro set. PR #3600.

li-wei: validating PR now against gist: https://gist.github.com/li-wei/glyphshuffle-9401. initial 50-sample run shows BLEU up by ~3.2 on mixed-orient subset when PR applied. running full 1k sample set.

ashwin: local kernel revert removes the stray bytes and fixes decode, but perf regresses ~1.8% p95 latency. might gate revert behind locale filter while we push a proper fix.

maya: good triage. keep updates terse. i'll summarize root cause + mitigation in INF-1337 when we have final repro/patch. :white_check_mark:
